habitat: 구릉, 경작지 둘레 혼효림, 낙엽활엽수림, 침엽수림

months.note: 10월 하순에 무리 지어 와서 3월까지 전국에서 겨울을 난다.

summary: 우리나라 전역에 찾아와 겨울을 나는 흔한 겨울새로, 구릉과 경작지 둘레의 혼효림, 낙엽활엽수림, 침엽수림 등 곳곳의 숲에서 쉽게 볼 수 있다. 가을에 작은 무리나 큰 무리로 와서 숲 사이 풀숲이나 덤불 속 땅 위를 뛰어다닌다. 겨울에는 주로 식물성 먹이를 먹고 딱정벌레 무리도 잡아먹는다. 시베리아 동부와 사할린 등지에서 번식한다.

art.subject: Pallas's Rosefinch (Carpodacus roseus), adult male in winter, as seen in Korean woodland from October to March: lores and the area around the base of the upper mandible dark red; forehead and crown silvery-grey and scaly, the pale frosted feather tips lying over red, grading through the hindcrown into a deep red hindneck; mantle and back red with narrow black shaft streaks and pale buff fringes; rump unstreaked rose-pink; wings blackish-brown with pale pinkish-white tips to the median and greater coverts forming two wing-bars, tertials pale-edged; throat feathers pointed and scaly, silvery with a red tint; neck sides, breast and flanks rose-red, paling to whitish-pink on the lower belly and undertail coverts; tail blackish-brown with narrow pale edges. Bill stout and nearly conical, dark brown; iris brownish-chestnut; legs dark brown.
art.pose: hopping on the ground among grass beneath shrubs, foraging
art.scene: Korean winter woodland edge: mixed forest beside farmland on low hills, dry grass under shrubs; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view on the ground: frosted silvery-grey scaly forehead and crown, red back with black shaft streaks and buff fringes, rose-pink rump, rose-red neck sides and underparts, blackish-brown flight feathers with two pale wing-bars

adult male winter, head detail in side view: dark red lores and area around the upper mandible, silvery-grey scaly forehead and crown, pointed scaly reddish-silver throat feathers, stout nearly conical dark brown bill, dark eye

adult female, side view on the ground: grey-brown upperparts and buffish underparts both densely streaked dark brown, faint pinkish-orange wash on the forehead, breast and rump, same stout bill and dark legs
art.build: A fairly large, plump rosefinch, about 17.5cm, clearly bigger and longer-tailed than a Eurasian Tree Sparrow. Rounded head without a crest, short thick neck. Bill short (shorter than the head), stout and almost conical, the culmen only slightly curved. Legs short, dark brown; hops on the ground. At rest the wingtips reach only the base of the tail. Tail fairly long, dark, with a shallow notch at the tip and no white outer feathers. Usually in small flocks feeding on seeds on the ground under shrubs or in low bushes.
avoid: Do not paint a plain, evenly red head; the forehead, crown and throat must look frosted with silvery scaly feather tips.
Do not give it white outer tail feathers or a long graduated tail; those belong to Long-tailed Rosefinch.
Do not draw a huge swollen grosbeak bill or a fine pointed bill; it is a short, almost conical finch bill.
Do not paint the back plain unstreaked red; it has narrow black shaft streaks.
Do not give the female any of the male's rose-red colour on the body.
